extraction.issue_description: The customer was billed twice for February, with two charges of Rs. 1,499 on 3 February and 5 February. The billing team confirmed the duplicate charge and the customer provided supporting documents including invoices and a bank statement.
extraction.resolution_provided: A refund of Rs. 1,499 was approved on 10 March and processed to the original payment method. The customer was informed that it will reflect within 5 to 7 working days.
